name: ArmorGreatAgain
teaser: FullSize armor will be great again
description_html:
mod that makes full-size armor useful again. It once again protects the old hitboxes, and most importantly, the abdomen and lower back. The mod has a config where you can add the IDs of armor should also apply or remove any of them.

INSTALL:
Drop to your main spt folder (where EFT.exe)
Enjoy!

-IOTV Gen4 body armor (Full Protection Kit, MultiCam)
